tasks.text: The use of layers is fundamental in professional image editing.
The PNG format is ideal for images with transparent backgrounds.
Resolution determines the level of detail in an image.
Vector graphics can be enlarged without loss of quality.
With retouching, we can eliminate distracting skin blemishes.
With selection tools, we can work precisely on the image.
The RGB color mode uses red, green, and blue colors.
CMYK colors are applied in printing houses.
With filters, we can add special effects to photos.
Non-destructive editing helps preserve original quality.
